inputRules.allowedInput: ASCII letters A-Z and a-z only
inputRules.normalization: ASCII uppercase after trimming and validation
inputRules.playInput: At most eight lines, including a trailing empty line; Unicode newlines and CRLF count as one line break each
inputRules.editorNewlines: Reject newline insertion if it leaves an affected nonfinal line empty or whitespace-only; reject over-limit edits and pastes without truncating; allow ordinary deletion
inputRules.playValidity: At least one nonempty line and all entries valid; malformed entries are invalid
inputRules.basePoints: Use words.point_value; excludes blanks, board multipliers, and bingo bonuses
